description: Temper plugin hooks: deterministic standalone-stage gate guarantee. stage-marker.sh (UserPromptSubmit) records which gate a /temper:{plan,build,review,check} session owes; verify-stage-gate.sh (Stop) refuses to end the session until .temper/gates.json carries a verdict for it — any verdict, PASS or FAIL. Both fail open on every path except the one detected violation. See docs/decisions/0005-deterministic-stage-gate-enforcement.md.
